skill.description: Generates pre-earnings previews and post-earnings analysis for US, Hong Kong, and A-share stocks using Longbridge data, consensus, valuation, segments, news, and filings.

security_audit.summary: Reviewed all 41 static findings and found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, arbitrary file access, or shell-injection path. remediation.suggestion: Normalize symbols to an allowlist such as letters, numbers, underscore, and dash before building RAW_DIR.

remediation.issue: The pre-earnings documentation uses a fixed /tmp/data.json example.
remediation.suggestion: Use a unique temporary filename in examples to avoid accidental overwrite or data mixing between runs.

remediation.issue: External Longbridge CLI and MCP data access is central to the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the network access disclosure prominent and require user setup or authentication before making data calls.

content.value_statement: Earnings reviews take time because data is spread across filings, estimates, news, and transcripts. This skill gathers Longbridge data and turns it into previews, summaries, and Markdown reports.
actual_capabilities: Runs scripts/collect.py to gather Longbridge snapshot, statements, consensus, EPS forecasts, quote, ratings, segments, news, and kline data.
Builds an eight-module post-earnings summary card with KPI, segment, trend, thesis, Street view, consensus, and risk sections.
Creates full Markdown earnings reports when the user asks for deeper research.
Creates pre-earnings previews covering prior guidance, recent events, call Q&A, and key watch points.
Applies DCF, trading comps, and precedent transaction methods from the included valuation guide.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI or MCP access for primary data collection.
May use web search for transcripts, recent events, and data gaps.
Does not provide personalized investment advice or guarantee price targets.
Full reports depend on data availability for the requested market and ticker.

use_cases.title: Review a Fresh Earnings Release
use_cases.description: Turn new quarterly results into a concise card with KPI variance, segment trends, guidance, consensus, and key risks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Before an Earnings Date
use_cases.description: Build a preview that compares prior guidance, recent events, analyst focus, and the questions to watch in the release.

use_cases.title: Draft a Deeper Research Note
use_cases.description: Create a Markdown earnings report with model updates, valuation methods, rating rationale, and cited source notes.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Earnings Card
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a default post-earnings summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use longbridge-earnings to analyze TSLA.US latest quarterly results. Give me the default summary card.

prompt_templates.title: Pre-Earnings Preview
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-earnings preview for 700.HK. Focus on prior guidance, recent events, and key questions to watch.

prompt_templates.title: Full Markdown Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Request a deeper written report after results are out.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a full Markdown earnings report for AAPL.US after the latest release. Include valuation math and source notes.

prompt_templates.title: Thesis Impact Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request focused on investment thesis changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze 600519.SH post-earnings results and explain whether the quarter strengthens, maintains, or weakens my thesis on margins and growth.

output: Tencent (700.HK) earnings summary with detected quarter, rating view, target price, and current price.
KPI, segment, margin, thesis, Street view, next-quarter consensus, and risk sections.
A short upgrade hint for users who need a full Markdown report.

output_examples.input: Full report for TSLA.US after earnings
output_examples.output: A Markdown research report with earnings summary, segment analysis, updated estimates, valuation range, rating decision, and sources.
An inline preview covering prior guidance, management outlook, last call themes, recent events, guidance history, consensus gaps, watch points, and risks.

best_practices: Provide a full ticker with market suffix, such as AAPL.US or 700.HK.
State whether you need a quick card, pre-earnings preview, or full report.
Review the detected quarter and correct it if fiscal calendar data looks wrong.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full report when a quick update is enough.
Do not treat generated ratings or price targets as personalized financial advice.
Do not request unsupported charts, DOCX files, or image outputs from this skill.

faq.question: Which markets does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports US, Hong Kong, and A-share stocks when Longbridge data is available for the ticker.

faq.question: Does it need the Longbridge CLI?
faq.answer: The primary workflow uses the Longbridge CLI. It can use the Longbridge MCP fallback when configured.

faq.question: Can it create a full research report?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a full report or research report to receive a Markdown earnings note.

faq.question: Does it use web search?
faq.answer: It uses web search for transcripts, recent events, and data gaps when the workflow requires them.

faq.question: Can it make charts or DOCX files?
faq.answer: No. It uses Markdown tables and simple text bars, and it does not create DOCX or image files.

faq.question: Is the output investment advice?
faq.answer: No. The output is research support and should not replace personal financial advice or professional review.
